title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids 'Black Non-Reflective' shoe casts the coveted sneaker in youth sizing for its June 2019 release. This non-reflective edition reprises many features from 2016's original 350 V2, including a flexible Primeknit upper with a translucent lateral stripe, heel loop and integrated lacing to personalize the fit. For a responsive feel below, adidas' revolutionary Boost cushioning takes position within a translucent TPU shell.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350
description: Following the ‘Turtle Dove’ and ‘Pirate’ colorways, the Yeezy Boost 350 ‘Moonrock’ features a moonrock/agate grey Primeknit upper and a moonrock Boost outsole. First previewed on Instagram by Kim Kardashian and released on November 14th, 2015, the Yeezy Boost 350 ‘Moon Rock’ was sold exclusively at stores that carried Yeezy Season One apparel.

title: YEEZY SLIDES
description: The adidas Yeezy Slides 'Core' 2020 showcases a monochromatic light brown hue throughout the exterior of the futuristic sandal, featuring open-toe construction on a cushy EVA foam build. Branding is limited to adidas’ three-stripe logo stamped on the footbed and a Yeezy wordmark on the lining of the upper. Underfoot, the outsole is treated to a series of deep horizontal grooves for soft cushioning and enhanced traction.
